ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota, including daycare fraud and misuse of state funds, and follow the money to determine the extent of the fraud and who is involved.
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved in the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota, and following the money will be key to determining the extent of the fraud and who is involved.
